newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach, Nat'l Express hit record highs.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach, Nat'l Express hit record highs.

text.p: Shares in transport groups Stagecoach Holdings Plc and National Express Group Plc sped to record highs on Friday, squeezed higher by continued investor demand, dealers and analysts said.
By 1250 GMT, Stagecoach was up 30-1/2p at 732-1/2 on volume of 1.4 million, after setting a record 735. National Express climbed 21p to 544-1/2 with 187,921 shares traded.
"They've been squeezed up again," said one analyst, who asked not to be named. "They are always in demand and there's often not a lot of stock around."
